key.name: base-path
key.summary: Extension base path to locate resources
key.description: The absolute filesystem path to the installed extension folder. Used for locating internal resources like icons and schemas.

key.name: icon-theme
key.description: The name of the icon theme to use for the extension's indicators. For example: "adwaita", "papirus".

key.name: proc-mon-enabled
key.description: Enable or disable real-time processor usage monitoring.

key.name: mem-mon-enabled
key.description: Enable or disable real-time memory usage monitoring.

key.name: proc-lbl-enabled
key.description: Show a numeric percentage label next to the processor indicator icon in the status area.

key.name: mem-lbl-enabled
key.description: Show a numeric percentage label next to the memory indicator icon in the status area.

key.name: lbl-monospace
key.description: Apply a monospace font to numeric indicator labels for consistent width.

key.name: lbl-fixed-width
key.description: Pad numeric labels to a fixed character width so the status area does not shift.

key.name: lbl-alignment
key.description: When fixed-width is enabled, align the numeric text to the left (pad right) or right (pad left).
